title: From Research to Practice: An Interactive Rapid Review of Autonomous Driving System Testing in Industry
abstract: arXiv:2605.00531v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Autonomous driving systems (ADS) are increasingly deployed in real traffic, yet testing remains fundamentally challenging due to open environments, complex scenarios, and the lack of established processes and acceptance criteria. Despite extensive research, a gap persists between academic advances and their applicability in industrial practice. To address this, we conduct an interactive rapid review in collaboration with 21 practitioners from a leading automotive company. Practitioners identified 12 key challenges in ADS testing, and prioritised two as the most critical issues, namely approaches to and completeness of testing for End-to-End (E2E) ADS. We analyzed 17 research studies relevant to these two challenges, most of which focus on generating critical testing scenarios, and subsequently assessed their relevance and applicability in practice. Our study provides the first practitioner-driven review and evaluation of current ADS

translated_title: 从研究到实践：工业界自动驾驶系统测试的交互式快速综述
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶系统（ADS）正越来越多地部署于真实交通环境中，但由于开放环境、复杂场景以及缺乏既定的测试流程和验收标准，测试仍然存在根本性的挑战。尽管已有大量研究，学术界的进展与其在工业实践中的适用性之间仍存在差距。为了解决这一问题，我们与一家领先汽车公司的21名从业者合作，开展了一项交互式快速综述。从业者识别出自动驾驶系统测试中的12个关键挑战，并将其中两个列为最关键的问题，即端到端（E2E）自动驾驶系统的测试方法及测试完备性。我们分析了与这两个挑战相关的17项研究，其中大多数聚焦于生成关键测试场景，并随后评估了这些研究在实践中的相关性和适用性。本研究首次提供了由从业者驱动的、对当前自动驾驶系统测试研究的综述与评估。
tldr: 本研究通过与21名汽车行业从业者合作的交互式快速综述，识别出自动驾驶系统测试的12个关键挑战，重点聚焦端到端系统的测试方法与完备性，并评估了17项相关研究在工业实践中的适用性，是首个由从业者驱动的研究综述。
en_tdlr: This study presents the first practitioner-driven interactive rapid review, collaborating with 21 practitioners to identify 12 key challenges in autonomous driving system testing and evaluate the practical applicability of 17 research studies on End-to-End ADS testing approaches and completeness.
